headline_item.title_zh: KKR拟斥资百亿美元收购EdgeCore，加码AI算力基建
headline_item.title_en: KKR in Talks to Buy EdgeCore at Valuation of at Least $8 Billion
headline_item.event_summary_zh: KKR拟通过旗下Helix平台以80亿至100亿美元收购数据中心运营商EdgeCore，以巩固AI算力供应链布局
headline_item.event_summary_en: Private equity firm KKR is in advanced negotiations to acquire data center operator EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure from Partners Group, with a valuation between $8 billion and $10 billion. The acquisition, executed through KKR's Helix platform, aims to consolidate EdgeCore's 2.27+ gigawatts of capacity across key U.S. markets to meet the insatiable demand for AI infrastructure.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】KKR & Co LP（收购方）、Partners Group（出让方）、EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure（标的）在全球数字基础设施与AI算力底层建设领域：拟以80亿至100亿美元收购EdgeCore多数股权，获取其2.27吉瓦规模的算力基础设施储备
【起因与机理】通过资本杠杆整合关键算力资产，以满足AI行业激增的底层算力需求
【关键数据与实测】标的估值区间为80亿至100亿美元，涉及超过2.27吉瓦的算力容量。
【各方立场与态度】反映资本市场对AI算力物理基础设施的长期持有价值认可。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] KKR & Co LP, Partners Group, EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure: Proposed acquisition of EdgeCore at an $8B-$10B valuation, securing 2.27GW of infrastructure capacity
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Scaling compute assets to meet the surging demand from AI model training and deployment
[Key Metrics] Valuation ranges from $8 billion to $10 billion, covering 2.27GW of power capacity.
[Key Position & Outlook] Reflects capital market appetite for long-term ownership of physical AI infrastructure assets.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 本笔交易标志着AI基础设施重心正从单纯的芯片竞争转向“能源与空间”的物理资产壁垒争夺。KKR通过Helix平台引入英伟达与主权基金背书，不仅是在进行资产并购，更是在构建底层算力供应链的金融化闭环，以缓解AI基建中日益突出的电力瓶颈与交付周期压力。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This deal signals a shift in AI infrastructure competition from pure silicon performance to the control of physical assets: power and real estate. By leveraging backing from Nvidia and sovereign funds for the Helix platform, KKR is orchestrating a financialized closed-loop for the AI supply chain to mitigate the escalating power bottlenecks and deployment lead times.

headlines.title_zh: GTA VI首日营收37.9亿美元，重塑娱乐业经济量级
headlines.title_en: Take-Two says GTA VI generated $3.79B in day-one sales, surpassing the $2.9B lifetime box-office gross of the highest-grossing film Avengers: Endgame (Jennifer Maas/Variety)
headlines.event_summary_zh: Take-Two旗下游戏《GTA VI》首日营收达37.9亿美元，打破全球单项娱乐产品首日销售记录
headlines.event_summary_en: Take-Two Interactive’s 'Grand Theft Auto VI', developed by Rockstar Games, generated $3.79 billion in sales on its launch day, surpassing the lifetime global box-office gross of 'Avengers: Endgame' and setting a new record for the entertainment industry. The title, released on PS5 and Xbox, priced at $80-$100, achieved a Metacritic score of 99, cementing its dominant position in interactive entertainment.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Take-Two Interactive（发行商）、Rockstar Games（开发商）、Sam Houser（创始人）在全球互动娱乐市场：首日销售额达37.9亿美元，打破单款娱乐产品历史最高单日营收记录
【起因与机理】基于强IP号召力、长周期研发投入与高质量游戏体验的市场爆发
【关键数据与实测】首日营收37.9亿美元，打破单项娱乐产品历史最高销售记录。
【各方立场与态度】Metacritic评分达99分，展现出极强的IP号召力与长期市场统治力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games, Sam Houser: Generated $3.79 billion in day-one sales, surpassing any historical single-day entertainment record
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Unprecedented IP loyalty, high-quality production, and massive pre-order demand
[Key Metrics] Day-one revenue reached $3.79 billion, breaking all-time single-product entertainment records.
[Key Position & Outlook] Achieved a Metacritic score of 99, reflecting immense IP influence and sustained market dominance.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 《GTA VI》的爆发表明，顶级游戏IP已取代传统好莱坞院线，成为全球文化消费的绝对核心。其单日37.9亿美元的吸金能力揭示了“互动娱乐+深度叙事+长周期变现”模式在跨代算力支持下，已具备远超流媒体与传统影视的单位变现价值，将倒逼全球内容产业向极高制作预算的“工业化单品”加速集聚。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The blockbuster launch of 'GTA VI' confirms that top-tier gaming IPs have eclipsed traditional Hollywood blockbusters as the core of global cultural consumption. Its $3.79 billion day-one performance demonstrates the superior unit-monetization potential of the 'interactive-narrative-long-tail' model, forcing the content industry to consolidate further into hyper-budgeted industrial-grade flagship titles.

headlines.title_zh: Signal封锁截图功能以防AI读取私密聊天
headlines.title_en: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
headlines.event_summary_zh: Signal在iOS与Android端强制拦截截图，旨在切断Meta Muse等AI智能体对端到端加密内容的读取通道
headlines.event_summary_en: Signal has implemented screenshot blocking on iOS 27 and specific Android versions to counter OS-level AI agents like Siri, Gemini, and Meta's Muse, which can scrape screen contents. Signal warns that these AI agents, often leveraging system-level permissions or accessibility tools, undermine end-to-end encryption by extracting decrypted messages directly from the display interface.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Signal (通讯平台)在iOS 27及Android操作系统端：限制屏幕截图功能，阻断AI助手通过辅助功能提取聊天数据
【起因与机理】AI智能体绕过端到端加密机制，直接抓取用户隐私内容
【核心事实细节】Signal封锁系统级截图以防AI抓取聊天内容。
【核心诉求与态度】呼吁操作系统厂商提供应用级屏蔽AI访问的标准化接口。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Signal (Communication Platform) (iOS 27 and Android OS): Blocking screenshots to prevent AI agents from scraping chat data via accessibility tools
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI agents are bypassing end-to-end encryption by accessing displayed messages
[Key Technical Spec] Signal blocks system-level screenshots to prevent AI scraping.
[Official Stance & Demand] Calls for standardized OS-level controls to restrict AI access to specific applications.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次技术博弈揭示了端到端加密在‘多模态AI驱动的OS’时代面临的降维打击，加密保护已从传输层延伸至视觉渲染层。随着操作系统与AI智能体的一体化，如何在保障用户便捷交互与防止敏感数据被模型训练/提取之间实现合规隔离，将成为下一代端侧隐私保护架构的核心竞技场。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This technical conflict reveals that end-to-end encryption faces a significant challenge in the era of multimodal, AI-integrated operating systems, shifting the focus from transport layer protection to the visual rendering layer. As OS and AI agents merge, the primary strategic challenge will be establishing privacy-preserving architectures that prevent model training or data extraction while maintaining user interface functionality.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
celebrity.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.

celebrity.thesis_en: Dissecting crucial inflection points in Yann LeCun on AI, highlighting system trade-offs and engineering shifts.
